meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 你给网址后，Claude 会用浏览器打开网页，把渲染后的内容转成干净、带标题等信息的 Markdown 文件并保存。支持页面加载完自动抓取，或等你示意后再抓取两种模式。
howto.when: 当你想把网页保存为 Markdown，并给出网址要求转换时触发。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 这个网页转成 Markdown 文件
say.note: Claude 会自动抓取网页，并生成 Markdown 文件

say.text: 这个网页要登录，等我提示后再抓成 Markdown
say.note: Claude 会进入等待模式，收到信号后才转换

howto.what_en: Fetches any URL via Chrome CDP and converts HTML to clean markdown. Renders the page in a real browser, extracts title/content, and saves a .md file with YAML metadata. Supports auto-capture on page load, or a wait mode where you signal when ready.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a webpage as Markdown and provides a URL. Also used for pages requiring login, lazy loading, or paywalls via the wait mode.

say_en.text: Save this page as a Markdown file: https://example.com
say_en.note: Automatically fetches the page and outputs a .md file.

say_en.text: This page needs login; wait until I signal before converting it to Markdown.
say_en.note: Enters wait mode and captures only after your signal.

say_en.text: Use wait mode to save https://example.com as Markdown.
say_en.note: It will ask you to confirm the page is ready before converting.
